title: Fix the three Android live-pass findings in the immersive recorders

completion_criteria.text: With self-view off, the video recorder's notice never says the camera is recording while the recorder is paused, and it keeps the spec 16.18 wording while recording.
completion_criteria.check: A widget test pumps VideoRecorderSheet paused with self-view off and asserts 'The camera is still recording.' is absent, and recording with self-view off asserts it is present; the paused test fails on main at ba529de.

completion_criteria.text: With the video let-go panel open, no full-window node is exposed to accessibility as a button labelled Leave; Leave is its own node (or disabled, matching voice).
completion_criteria.check: A semantics widget test on VideoRecorderSheet with asking true in the bottom-bar layout finds a separate Leave node and no window-sized node with the button flag, failing on main at ba529de; on the phone, uiautomator dump in that state shows no 1080x2195 clickable node labelled Leave.

completion_criteria.text: On a 411 dp wide phone in the bottom-bar layout, the idle video recorder's camera chip shows a readable camera name instead of 'Back cam…'.
completion_criteria.check: A widget test at 411x869 logical px with two cameras, one named 'Back camera 1', asserts the chip label is not truncated, failing on main at ba529de; a phone screenshot of the idle video recorder shows the full name or the chosen short form.
flutter analyze reports no issues and the full flutter test suite exits 0 on the fix branch.

spine.active_goal: Fix the three defects the 2026-09-28 Android live pass found in the full-window video recorder (shipped in #229 and #231): the self-view-off notice claims the camera is recording while paused, the Leave control merges into a full-screen TalkBack node while the let-go panel is open, and the camera chip truncates the camera name on phones. Each fix ships with a test that fails without it, then gets a live check on the phone.
spine.next_step: Ask the owner what the self-view-off notice should say while paused (spec 16.18 only defines the recording wording), then start with the TalkBack defect in lib/features/capture/immersive/recorder_surface.dart at `_leave()` (the `Semantics(button: true, label: recorderLeaveLabel)` around line 264), deciding with it whether video Leave should be disabled while the let-go panel is open as voice already does (video_recorder_sheet.dart line 288 versus voice_recorder_sheet.dart line 202).
spine.last_session: 2026-09-28: Android live pass on a plain test build (dev.satanshumishra.field_notes.plain, from main ba529de) on the owner's Galaxy Note 10+ (SM-N975W, Android 12, gesture navigation). Onboarding, skip path, Settings and both recorders passed end to end with no crashes or Flutter errors; three minor video-recorder defects were found and deferred to this thread by the owner. The test app was uninstalled afterwards (its voice note and reminder alarms went with it) and phone scratch files were removed.

open_risks.text: Issue 1 detail: the notice text is the constants videoSelfViewOffTitle ('The camera is still recording.') and videoSelfViewOffMessage ('You just won’t see yourself.') at video_recorder_sheet.dart lines 36-37, drawn by _selfViewOffCopy (around line 356) whenever self-view is off (line 350, `if (hidden)`), regardless of phase. Seen live: self-view off, status 'Paused. Nothing’s lost.', notice still 'The camera is still recording.' Spec 16.18 defines only the recording wording, so the paused wording is an owner decision (for example 'Recording is paused. You just won’t see yourself.', or hiding the title while paused).

open_risks.scope: TalkBack Leave node while the video let-go panel is open
open_risks.text: Issue 2 detail and unverified hypothesis: uiautomator in the video recorder's asking state (paused, let-go panel open, bottom bar) showed one clickable 1080x2195 node labelled 'Leave / What do you want to remember about today?' and no separate Leave node; in idle and recording, Leave was its own 126x126 node, and voice's asking state keeps a separate disabled Leave. The Leave control's Semantics in recorder_surface.dart `_leave()` (around line 264) has button, enabled and label but no container: true, so when its sibling nodes change in the asking state its configuration likely merges up into the full-window node. Video also keeps Leave enabled while asking (video_recorder_sheet.dart line 288, `onLeave: _isSaving ? null : widget.onLeave`), while voice disables it (voice_recorder_sheet.dart line 202, `_saving || asking ? null : onCancel`). Confirm with a semantics test before fixing.

Issue 2 overlaps a separately queued screen-reader task from session a22e2001 (task_4dc1b80e): the recorders' static text merges into the full-window node's accessible name (the question and privacy text read as the area's label) and the no-camera message is not its own node. Both touch semantics in recorder_surface.dart; do them together or sequence them so two branches do not rewrite the same Semantics wrappers.

Issue 3 detail: the chip is CameraPicker (camera_picker.dart `_face`, a Flexible Text with maxLines 1 and TextOverflow.ellipsis), placed Flexible in video_recorder_sheet.dart `_trailing` (around line 384) beside SelfViewChip, and shown only while idle with more than one camera. In the bottom-bar top band it got 240x126 px (about 91 dp) next to 'Only you' and 'Mirror on', so 'Back camera 1' rendered as 'Back cam…'. The chip was restyled in the immersive-video Lane (commit 4678b3d). Check the prototype's phone video recorder in docs/prototype/project/Field Notes.dc.html before choosing between short names (Back, Front), an icon-only chip, or more width.

key_decisions.title: Defer the three Android live-pass findings to a parked thread

Owner design call, pending: in the video recorder, Command-Return still keeps the take while the 'Let this one go?' panel is open, while voice turns it off there; the key hint describes it truthfully since #231.

Live checks not yet done for the onboarding, recorders and settings spec: the Android 13+ notification prompt on skip (the test phone is Android 12), a hardware keyboard on Android (16.17, via the uhid method in the testing memory), an actual TalkBack run (the pass read the uiautomator tree only), side-by-side comparison with the prototype screenshots (16.9, 16.23, 16.40), the Data-tab notice persisting across tabs (16.6, needs Delete all on test data), macOS live video with a real camera (the Parallels guest has none), and the device integration tests integration_test/capture_ui_flow_test.dart and the composer probe.

Pre-existing observation, not from this work: under gesture navigation on the test phone, uiautomator clips every node at y=2195 px, so bottom-edge controls (the shell bottom bar at 26.7 dp, the onboarding footer buttons at 37.7 dp) read below 48 dp; judge on a 3-button-navigation device or from code before treating it as a defect.
